page.layout: One column of running text. Printed page 177 at top right, with running head "PARS SECVNDA." at top centre. One marginal note at the right, beside the first line. Left-edge fragments belong to the neighbouring page and are not transcribed. Signature "S 3" and catchword "ceptā" at the foot.

main_text.p: Illius nostri cælestis qui facit ut sol suus exoria-Mat.5.tur super malos & bonos, & pluit super iustos ac iniustos, non ulla dignitate aut virtute nostra adductus, sed sola benignitate & munificentia sua. quid enim terra ad rorem supernè obtinendum facit? Deus idem auctor est & faciendi & demittendi roris: eam non terra meretur; sed largitur gratia, qua naturæ ordinem constituit Deus. Vt itaq. nec Hermon, nec Sion fecerunt quidquam ad habendum rorem; ita etiam de nobis profiteamur coram Domino necesse est. Descendit amor infinitus illius ad nos vehementissimè; at non vicissim ad illum ascendit pusillus noster: efficit ille amor & rorem benedictionum & effecta singula ex rore illo procedentia. Nos igitur, qui tam gratiosa benignitate patris cælestis nostri in communione sanctorum participes efficimur roris cælestis illius; quo studio, qua contentione tenemur laborare, obsecro, ut istas benedictiones Dei refundamus, & gratum animum nostrum omni officio ac potius pietate Deo testatum faciamus?

- At non refundit terra, nec reppendit cælo, à quo perfusa est. bene est: Nam eadem quoque ratione res à se acceptas per nos Deus refundi postulat; Nec terra refundit cælo, nec nos Domino refundimus; sed cum terra refundat creatis rebus aliis, in quarum commodum fructus ipsius instituti sunt, ac proinde hominibus ipsis sit parens & altrix benefica; utrumque nobis tenendum est; nec posse nos Deo beneficia accepta

page.notes: Left-edge fragments (ipi, bis, etc.) are show-through or the neighbouring page and are omitted. Catchword "ceptā" is the first word of the next page, printed with a macron over the a. The paragraph break before "- At non" is inferred from the dash opening the line. Uncertain readings: "reppendit" and the marginal reference "Mat.5." (printed as "Mat.5:" in the scan) are copied as best read.
